en: A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a town square bordered by multi‑storey buildings and, in the background, a large fortified complex with high stone walls and a prominent cylindrical tower. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk and stand in the square, and an old car is visible. Mountains rise behind the castle. Caption text is printed along the lower border.
